scenarios.name: quiet_inside_levels
scenarios.description: Price moves inside the levels. No crossing, but state advances.

scenarios.name: stop_crossed_once
scenarios.description: The tick that breaches the stop fires once; later ticks below it do not.

scenarios.name: stop_touched_exactly
scenarios.description: Touching the level is breaching it.

scenarios.name: transient_breach_and_recovery
scenarios.description: A spike through the stop that retraces still fires, and the extremes remember it.

scenarios.name: target_reached
scenarios.description: A target crossing is a warning, not an exit.

scenarios.name: short_mirrors_the_levels
scenarios.description: A short is stopped above and targets below.

scenarios.name: invalidation_without_a_stop
scenarios.description: A named invalidation price fires on its own.

scenarios.name: stop_and_invalidation_same_tick
scenarios.description: Evaluation order is stop, then invalidation, then target, and it is stable.

scenarios.name: unarmed_symbol_is_tracked_but_silent
scenarios.description: State advances for a symbol with no commitment; no event is produced.

scenarios.name: multiple_symbols_are_independent
scenarios.description: One symbol crossing does not disturb another.

scenarios.name: non_positive_price_is_ignored
scenarios.description: A zero or negative price does not advance state and produces nothing.

scenarios.name: extremes_track_the_whole_window
scenarios.description: Running high and low span every accepted tick, not just the endpoints.

scenarios.name: approach_bands_fire_on_the_tick
scenarios.description: Entering the stop band and the target band each fire once, and neither is protective.

scenarios.name: a_spike_that_reverses_between_polls
scenarios.description: A 3.5% move that returns inside fourteen seconds is invisible to a poll and is caught here.

scenarios.name: velocity_forgets_prices_outside_the_window
scenarios.description: The same move spread beyond the velocity window is a drift, not a jump.

scenarios.name: vwap_deviation_against_a_pushed_value
scenarios.description: Deviation is judged against the bar plane's VWAP, and a new VWAP reopens the question.

scenarios.name: volume_spike_inside_the_minute
scenarios.description: Volume is cumulative for the session; the minute in progress is the delta from its first tick.

scenarios.name: volume_counter_going_backwards_re_anchors
scenarios.description: A reconnect restarts the cumulative counter; the delta must not go negative or fire falsely.

scenarios.name: protection_is_never_displaced_by_a_signal
scenarios.description: A stop crossing and an attention signal on the same tick both appear, stop first.

scenarios.name: an_unwatched_symbol_produces_no_signals
scenarios.description: Detection is off unless a watch asks for it; an armed symbol still protects.
